失败反馈的价值，在于帮助用户继续推进任务，而不只是说明“暂时做不到”。: Failure responses should help users continue a task, rather than merely explain that it cannot be done.
报告区分能力解释、手动指引、界面接管与恢复路径，指出不同兜底方式的体验差异。: The report distinguishes capability explanations, manual guidance, interface handoff and recovery paths.
现有记录支持行为分析；是否真正恢复并完成任务，需要后续实测验证。: Existing records support behavioral analysis; verified recovery and eventual completion require further testing.
知识与出行形成相对优势，车控兑现仍是优先改进项。: Knowledge and travel are relative strengths, while reliable vehicle control remains an improvement priority.
路线规划与车书知识表现较强，车控对象修正和补能条件筛选存在差距。: Route planning and vehicle knowledge are stronger; correcting control targets and filtering charging conditions show gaps.
结合六域画像、行业样本与真实案例，明确产品亮点和改进优先级。: Domain profiles, industry samples and real cases identify product strengths and improvement priorities.
常用用车任务具备较好的兑现基础，动态信息与生成能力仍有明确边界。: Common vehicle tasks have a strong delivery foundation, while dynamic information and generation retain clear limits.
车书知识、组合操作与使用指导是优势，改口和动态服务需要进一步完善。: Vehicle knowledge, combined operations and usage guidance are strengths; corrections and dynamic services need further work.
总体分数之外，报告拆解六域与细分场景，区分常用任务优势和完整能力范围。: Beyond the overall score, domain and scenario analysis separates everyday strengths from the full capability scope.
出行体验的关键，是从“回答问题”走向“完成任务”。: Travel experience depends on moving from answering questions to completing tasks.
ET5的差距集中在多目的地、条件修正、口语需求与目的地串联。: ET5 gaps concentrate in multiple destinations, condition changes, conversational requests and destination sequences.
报告按任务选择可学习的标杆，将理解、任务状态和服务连接转化为改进方向。: Task-specific benchmarks turn understanding, task state and service integration into concrete improvement directions.
极氪是优先学习对象，银河的执行表现也值得重点研究。: Zeekr is a priority benchmark, while Galaxy execution performance also deserves close study.
多点规划的难度来自顺序、约束和任务衔接，不能只用站点数量衡量。: Planning difficulty comes from order, constraints and task continuity, not simply the number of stops.
通过典型案例提炼可复制的规划与执行机制，而不止比较品牌排名。: Representative cases reveal reusable planning and execution mechanisms beyond brand rankings.
Livis阶段总体表现改善，但局部变化需要分别审视。: Overall performance improves in the Livis stage, while local changes require separate review.
多地点与组合任务组织增强，图像生成取消属于功能范围取舍。: Multi-destination and combined task organization improve; image generation removal is a product-scope choice.
小样本比例波动不等于能力退化；持续短板与明确功能取消应分别验证。: Small-sample fluctuations do not establish regression; persistent gaps and explicit removals require separate validation.

Pro 包含哪些测试与报告？: What tests and reports does Pro include?
Pro 包含 Plus 全部权益，增加每年 5 款指定车型的独立测试及定制化报告: Pro includes all Plus access, individual testing of 5 commissioned vehicle models per year, custom reports and 10 named users. One software version is agreed per model; custom report topics, scope, quantity and schedule are agreed per project.
五款车型可以换成同一款车的五个版本吗？: Can five versions of one vehicle replace five models?

Plus 和 Pro 可以购买哪些增值包？: Which add-ons can Plus and Pro purchase?
Plus 和 Pro 均可另购 MCP 数据接入、Workshop 和定制咨询。: Both Plus and Pro can purchase MCP integration, workshops and custom consulting. Add-ons are not included by default; scope, deliverables and pricing are agreed separately.
订阅是否包含所有新车型与实时更新？: Are all new vehicles and real-time updates included?
